definitions.explanation: A writer of exceptional talent and lasting influence. Used to describe authors whose works have become part of the literary canon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏目|なつめ}{漱石|そうせき}→夏目漱石：30575_natsumesouseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文豪|ぶんごう}だ。
examples.english: Natsume Soseki is a great Japanese author.

examples.japanese: {文豪|ぶんごう}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{愛|あい}した→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|たず}ねた→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧。
examples.english: I visited the inn that was loved by the literary masters.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文豪|ぶんごう}⟦ゆかり→ゆかり：10650_yukari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地|ち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: In this town, many sites associated with Meiji-era literary masters still remain.

notes:
USAGE:
A respectful title used for established, canonical writers. In Japan, often applied to Meiji- and Taisho-era novelists such as ⟦{夏目|なつめ}{漱石|そうせき}→夏目漱石：30575_natsumesouseki⟧, {太宰|だざい}{治|おさむ}, {芥川|あくたがわ}{龍之介|りゅうのすけ}, and ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧{鷗外|おうがい}. Not typically used for living authors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文豪|ぶんごう}: great Japanese author
- {文豪|ぶんごう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: works of a literary master
- {文豪|ぶんごう}⟦ゆかり→ゆかり：10650_yukari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地|ち}: places associated with a literary master

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: writer, author (general, neutral)
- ⟦{小説家|しょうせつか}→小説家：03070_shousetsuka⟧: novelist (neutral)
